title: Christina Ricci Celebrates Father's Day Amid Ongoing Custody Dispute with Ex-Husband
text:
Actress Christina Ricci shared a loving Father's Day tribute to husband Mark Hampton while a recent sealed court filing reveals a dismissed emergency custody bid by her ex-husband James Heerdegen involving their son Freddie.
Actress Christina Ricci celebrated Father's Day with a heartfelt social media post honoring her second husband, Mark Hampton . The message, which included a photo of Hampton with both of Ricci's children, her son Freddie from her previous marriage to James Heerdegen and her daughter Cleo with Hampton, expressed deep affection and gratitude.
Ricci wrote, Happy Father's Day!!!!!! The best dad we could have ever hoped for, and I honestly didn't know they made them like you, babe. I am so grateful for you. We LOVE you so much @markhamptonhair.
This public tribute highlights the couple's solid relationship within a complex blended family dynamic. However, behind this serene family image, a recent legal dispute with her ex-husband over their son Freddie had unfolded. Court documents obtained reveal that Heerdegen filed an ex parte request for a change in custody following an alleged incident in early June.
Heerdegen's petition was based on text messages from Freddie, then 11, claiming Ricci had consumed alcohol during a flight to Canada and used certain words to describe her behavior afterward. Ricci has previously been open about using alcohol to cope with fame in her younger years. The situation quickly evolved; according to the filings, Freddie told his father's lawyers a day later that he had overreacted and had no fear of being in his mother's primary custody.
Seeking to protect her son's privacy, Ricci requested the original text messages be sealed, citing that Freddie was starting a new school and had a history of bullying. On June 23, the judge granted Ricci's motion to seal the messages and denied Heerdegen's emergency custody request, a significant legal victory for Ricci. This custody battle is the latest chapter in Ricci's divorce from Heerdegen, which was finalized after a tumultuous period.
Ricci filed for divorce in July 2020 after obtaining a protective order against Heerdegen. Heerdegen denied any wrongdoing and was not arrested following a domestic battery call at their home in June 2020. Their divorce settlement, however, established a shared legal custody arrangement for Freddie. The financial terms also included a one-time payment from Ricci to Heerdegen of $189,687.
Amidst this ongoing co-parenting challenge, Ricci's personal life moved forward. She married Mark Hampton, a hair stylist, in an intimate Los Angeles ceremony in October 2021. Their daughter Cleo was born two months later, in December 2021. Ricci often speaks warmly of her family, as seen in an acceptance speech where she thanked Hampton as the most supportive and loving husband, praised Freddie for reconnecting her to art and ambition, and described baby Cleo as gorgeous and spirited.
The juxtaposition of the public Father's Day praise with the recent sealed court proceedings underscores the intricate balance celebrities must maintain between public personas and private family legal matters, especially within blended families where past conflicts can resurface. The judge's decision to seal the texts reflects a common judicial priority to protect minor children from the potential stigma of having their family disputes become public record, particularly when bullying is a concern.
While the immediate emergency threat was dismissed, the underlying custody agreement remains in place, requiring Ricci and Heerdegen to continue co-parenting under a court-approved framework
